entries.title: Psalms 100:1
segments:
All nations are called upon to praise Jehovah as their creator, preserver, and benefactor.  This psalm contains, like many others, a prophetic anticipation of the conversion of all the gentile nations. 
 
As the Lord is good to all, all should unite in praising and adoring him.

entries.title: Psalms 100:3
segments:
Not we; men must not take to themselves the glory of their own powers, or privileges. 
 
The grace of God is the cause of all the distinctions among the children of men, whereby one has richer blessings and is more favored than another.

entries.title: Psalms 100:4
segments: His gates; the place in which he is worshipped.

entries.title: Psalms 100:5
segments: Jehovah is the same yesterday, today, and for ever; none who put their trust in him will be disappointed.
